goal: Take a pretrained model and fine-tune it (SFT) to perform 4 document-analysis tasks by instruction — with a single instruction-following model.

tasks.title: Summarize
tasks.instruction: Summarize the key point of the document
tasks.description: Condense the document to its key point.

tasks.title: Identify highlights
tasks.instruction: Identify what stands out most in document
tasks.description: Pick out what stands out most in the document.

tasks.title: Analyze themes
tasks.instruction: Analyze the main themes and patterns
tasks.description: Break down the main themes and patterns.

tasks.title: Brief report
tasks.instruction: Create brief report of document takeaways
tasks.description: Assemble a brief report of document takeaways.

model_types.name: task-oriented assistant
model_types.note: The 4 tasks are the assistant's tasks.

model_types.name: question-answering
model_types.note: A 5th task, if you add Q&A over the document.

model_types.name: multi-turn with history
model_types.note: Only needed for follow-up dialogue about the document.

model_types.name: emotional / personalized
model_types.note: Not directly related to document analysis.
